mapper.select: SELECT cache_idx, cache_id, source_type, source_pk, field_name, source_text, source_text_hash, target_lang, translated_text, provider, created_at, updated_at FROM SPOT_TEXT_TRANSLATION_CACHE WHERE source_type = #{sourceType} AND source_pk = #{sourcePk} AND field_name = #{fieldName} AND source_text_hash = #{sourceTextHash} AND target_lang = #{targetLang} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SPOT_TEXT_TRANSLATION_CACHE ( cache_id, source_type, source_pk, field_name, source_text, source_text_hash, target_lang, translated_text, provider ) VALUES ( #{cacheId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourcePk}, #{fieldName}, #{sourceText}, #{sourceTextHash}, #{targetLang}, #{translatedText}, #{provider} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE translated_text = VALUES(translated_text), provider = VALUES(provider), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
